works.body:
Hello there! Once again, thank you for taking my previous requests! They are truly amazing!
This time, I would like an illustration of another character. His name is Dante Daedalus.
He is a time-traveler of sorts, watching over the different timelines and ensuring they stay within working continuity.
I would like an illustration of him playing the role of Santa Claus, going into someone's house and leaving gifts under a Christmas tree. He does this to ensure that as many people experience a good Christmas and the timeline doesn't fall out of congruency. You don't have to replace his whole outfit with Santa Claus' outfit, but you can make him wear the big red coat and the red hat. Thank you very much!

Character Reference: https://x.com/DanteDaedalusVT/status/1755375065942913035
Setting reference: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1528963411/santa-claus-leaving-presents-under-tree

Hi, I really liked the artwork you previously made for me!
For this request, I would like a drawing of the character Tiresias Bazaar and another copy of him facing him. You can use the background reference for the poses.
The original Tiresias Bazaar is on the right side, looking towards the left, while a shadow/darker copy of Tiresias is on the left, looking back towards the original Tiresias.
The shadow Tiresias looks very angry, with fire-red eyes glowing at night, and looks like a darker silhouette of the original Tiresias. 
The original Tiresias retains the original bright colors as shown in the character reference sheet, looking back at the shadow Tiresias. The original Tiresias has a stern expression on his face, not as angry as the shadow Tiresias.
You can keep the pyramids behind them and the moon in the sky between the two characters.

Background reference:
https://files.catbox.moe/4cw9o9.jpg
Character reference:
https://x.com/Tiresias_Bazaar/status/1841562986030497932/photo/1

Hello! I saw your artwork on pixiv and I really like it! I would like for you to draw an illustration using the character below.
The character's name is Tiresias Bazaar. He is an arrogant knight who traveled far, in search of something he feels he lost.
For the illustration, I would like him sitting by a campfire, hunched over. He looks exhausted from traveling a lot.  I would like it if you could draw him in a similar setting to the background/environment. I would like to use the image for my Twitch and Twitter. Thank you so much!

Background/environment: https://www.reddit.com/r/DigitalArt/comments/15sxn1q/warrior/
Character reference: https://x.com/Tiresias_Bazaar/status/1841562986030497932/photo/1

Hello,
Please draw my Vtuber. She is a manticore. She is a tomboy. Please draw her in an expressive pose and with an expressive expression!
I would appreciate it if you could provide me with a PSD format that separates the background and character.

Here is the Vtuber design: https://imgur.com/a/ida-design-QMsz3oJ


This art will be used for SNS, such as Twitter, YouTube, so please reject the application if this isn't allowed.

Thank you!

Hello! I would like to request an illustration of V&U vtuber Cyon Hart. She is usually a cute, silly, and clumsy tanuki thief. Here I would like her to be drawn like the mummy girl in the reference URL. I would like the pose and clothes to be similar, but feel free to adjust the details to suit your style better. If possible, please provide a version with transparent background. Thank you for your time!

https://imgur.com/a/ChwtlvH
